nodes.description: Storage.State struct holding all protocol accounting (epoch, balances, provider, accounts, epochs, candidates) in the proxy storage slot
Total outstanding debt tracked in _state.balance.debt, mutated by incrementTotalDebt/decrementTotalDebt
Total bonded ETHCS tracked in _state.balance.bonded
Redeemable balance pool _state.balance.redeemable
Total outstanding coupon balance _state.balance.coupons
IEthic token reference used for mint/burn/transfer/transferFrom
IOracle reference used by the regulator to capture price
Per-account staged balance _state.accounts[a].staged
Per-account fluidUntil/lockedUntil lock timestamps controlling permission modifiers
EIP-1967 implementation slot 0x3608...2bbc read/written by Getters/Upgradeable
External epoch advance: incentivizes caller and treasury, then runs Bonding/Regulator/Market step, emits Advance with block.timestamp
Public initializer guarded by `initializer` modifier; incentivizes msg.sender with INITIALIZE_INCENTIVE
Private helper that mints reward via mintToAccount and emits Incentivization
External deposit guarded by onlyFrozenOrLocked: pulls tokens via transferFrom and credits staged balance
External withdraw guarded by onlyFrozenOrLocked: transfers tokens to msg.sender then decrements staged balance
External bond guarded by onlyFrozenOrFluid: converts staged ETHC into bonded ETHCS shares
External unbond guarded by onlyFrozenOrFluid: burns bonded shares back to staged balance
External unbondUnderlying guarded by onlyFrozenOrFluid: converts underlying value to staged balance
External coupon purchase: burns ETHC from msg.sender and credits coupon balance including premium
External coupon redemption: decrements coupon balance, computes burn penalty, transfers redeem amount to msg.sender
External coupon transfer with allowance deduction when msg.sender != sender
External coupon allowance approval for spender
External governance vote guarded by onlyFrozenOrLocked; may create candidate, tallies approve/reject and places lock
External commit that validates quorum/approval and upgrades proxy to candidate implementation
External emergency commit bypassing quorum using super majority + emergency delay, then upgrades proxy
Internal upgrade routine: sets implementation then delegatecalls candidate initialize()
Private routine validating contract code and sstore-ing the EIP-1967 implementation slot
Internal routine minting ETHC and increasing debt outside bootstrapping, then balanceCheck
Internal routine pulling ETHC via transferFrom, burning it and decrementing total debt
Internal routine transferring ETHC to account and decrementing redeemable balance
Pure function computing coupon premium from supply/debt/amount via effectivePremium curve
View function computing redemption penalty using block.timestamp modulo epoch period and coupon age
Internal epoch step: snapshots total bonded and increments epoch when epochTime exceeds current epoch
Internal regulator step: captures oracle price and grows/shrinks supply
Internal market step: expires prior coupons and initializes coupon expiration for current epoch
Private invariant check that contract ETHC balance covers bonded+staged+redeemable
Internal supply increase distributing pool/treasury/DAO rewards and trueing up redeemable pool
Private routine capturing oracle price, returning bootstrapping price or neutral price when invalid
Private routine clamping supply delta to supply change limit (or coupon limit)
Private view checking whether an account's stake exceeds proposal threshold
Caller-controlled address used as beneficiary, voter and permission subject across external entry points
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for epoch math and coupon redemption penalty
External ETHC transfer call sending tokens to a caller-influenced address before accounting updates
External ETHC transferFrom pull over an arbitrary token contract
delegatecall into the candidate implementation executing initialize() in proxy context
External mint call arbitrarily increasing ETHC supply (privileged token role)
External burn call destroying ETHC held by the contract
Inline-assembly sstore writing the implementation slot, bypassing Solidity storage safety

withdraw value parameter determines transferred amount

recipient parameter of transferCoupons receives coupon balance
sender parameter of transferCoupons is debited

ethicAmount parameter is burned from the purchaser
candidate parameter is voted on and potentially upgraded to

candidate parameter is validated and passed to upgradeTo
newImplementation parameter becomes the proxy implementation target
balance local carries the computed share amount in bond
staged local carries the computed staged amount in unbond
bonded local holds msg.sender stake used for vote weighting

normalization_plan.reason: value is solely the amount argument of deposit and carries no independent semantics
value is solely the amount argument of withdraw
value is solely the amount argument of bond
amount is solely the mint quantity argument
account is solely the mint recipient argument
recipient is solely the coupon transfer destination argument
spender is solely the allowance target argument
sender is solely the coupon debit source argument
epoch is solely the coupon epoch index argument
couponEpoch is solely the redemption epoch index argument
couponAmount is solely the redemption quantity argument
ethicAmount is solely the purchase quantity argument
candidate is solely the governance candidate argument feeding vote/commit
vote is solely the APPROVE/REJECT selector argument
newImplementation is solely the upgrade target argument
balance is a temporary share computation owned entirely by bond
staged is a temporary conversion result owned entirely by unbond
bonded is a temporary snapshot of the voter stake inside vote
price is a temporary oracle return value inside oracleCapture
couponAmount is a temporary premium result credited by purchaseCoupons
burnAmount is a temporary penalty result inside redeemCoupons
